title: WOLVERINE BERSERKER RAGE
description: Pack for Absolute Enchantments that changes the Ground Pound sound effects.
body:
This pack is meant for my [Absolute Enchantments mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/absolute-enchantments-minecraft-dungeons-doom-based-enchants). Which hopefully will be published by the time this pack has been approved. It changes the sound effects of the Ground Pound enchantment to use the Marvel Rival's Wolverine ultimate sound effect:
